items.q: How do I change my password?
items.a: Go to Profile > Security > Change Password. You will need to provide your current password.

items.q: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
items.a: Go to Profile > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and choose email or authenticator app.

items.q: I think my account was hacked. What do I do?
items.a: Use Profile > Security > Freeze Account immediately, then contact support.

items.q: How do I add my medical aid details?
items.a: Go to Profile > Medical Aid and fill in your scheme, plan and member number.

items.q: Where can I see my claims?

items.a: Profile > Billing > Transactions; tap any transaction to download the receipt.
